meta.title: Agent Reliability Research
meta.description: A small example Knowledge Pack for systematic research communication.

nodes.title: Agent Reliability
nodes.summary: How agentic systems remain correct, observable and recoverable under real-world failures.

nodes.title: Failure Model
nodes.summary: Identify where an agent can fail across model, context, tools and orchestration.

nodes.title: Tool Failure
nodes.summary: Tools can timeout, reject inputs, return partial data or produce ambiguous errors.

nodes.title: Context Drift
nodes.summary: Long-running tasks can accumulate irrelevant or contradictory context.

nodes.title: Retry Budget
nodes.summary: Retries need explicit limits so recovery attempts do not amplify cost or failure.

nodes.title: Trace Evaluation
nodes.summary: Evaluate complete agent traces to locate failure patterns and regressions.

nodes.title: Human Approval Gate
nodes.summary: Require explicit approval before high-impact or irreversible actions.

nodes.title: Failure Taxonomy
nodes.summary: Classify failures consistently so fixes target the correct system layer.

nodes.title: Production Trace Dataset
nodes.summary: A curated evidence set used to test and communicate observed agent failure modes.

inbox.title: Provider outage vs agent-design failure
inbox.note: Keep external provider failures separate from orchestration failures in the taxonomy.
